title: Lessons from Metoyer and playing for the cabaret shows
summary: After tape change, Hightower says he learned most from Metoyer and describes playing the cabaret for visiting theatre acts.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: And he went along in the district for a little while after. He didn't play many more places. He just played around. He'd come into places. He never lost friendships with me. And I did come to my head that I wanted to take lessons from him. So I went down to his house and taken lessons. And I found out that I got more out of Anormatwire than I did out of the rest of the people that had showed me anything in the music business. So I rapped so fast and playing in the cabaret at night, and all those white shows come in there. We used them shows in there, all the acts and singing from the Crescent Theatre and all them places used to come.
